title: Glazing Software with Xero | Invoices, Payments & Supplier Bills | Coglass
description: Coglass pushes invoices, payments and supplier bills to Xero, coded to the sales accounts, bank account and VAT or GST rates you choose from your own Xero organisation.
lead: Connect your Xero organisation once. Invoices go to Xero when you send them, payments you record in Coglass follow, and supplier bills go in as bills — each coded to the accounts and tax rates you pick from your own Xero.
steps_h2: Set it up once, then forget about it
steps_sub: Mapping uses your real Xero accounts and tax rates, read from your organisation.
steps: Sign in to Xero from Settings and pick your organisation.
Choose the sales account, the bank account for payments, the expense account for supplier bills and the tax rate for each VAT or GST rate.
An invoice goes to Xero when it is sent; the customer is created as a Xero contact the first time.
Payments recorded in Coglass are added to the invoice in Xero, against the bank account you chose.
inc_sub: No exporting spreadsheets, no typing invoices twice.
included: Deposit and final invoices, with line amounts and tax.
Recorded against the invoice in Xero, into the bank account you map.
Supplier invoices go in as Xero bills, with purchase tax coded separately from sales.
One sales account, or different ones per job type or product category.
Each of your sales and purchase rates mapped to the matching Xero tax rate.
Customers are created in Xero the first time they are invoiced, and you can import your Xero contacts into Coglass.
Each invoice is pushed once and remembered, so re-sending does not create a second copy.
cta_h2: Let Xero keep up with the job
cta_p: Book a demo and we will connect a Xero demo company — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
